parts.name: Drawer (Top)
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer located at the top section of the table, typically rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items such as stationery or documents.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out along rails for access.

parts.name: Drawer (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: A middle-positioned wooden drawer of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides additional storage space for medium-sized items.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out along rails for access.

parts.name: Drawer (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: A bottom-positioned wooden drawer of the table, larger than the upper drawers.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing larger or heavier items.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out along rails for access.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A thin wooden panel attached to the back of the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural stability and prevents items from falling out the back.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel forming the left side of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the tabletop and drawers, providing structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel forming the right side of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the tabletop and drawers, providing structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Middle Divider)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical divider panel separating the drawers within the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides internal support and separates drawer compartments.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden panel forming the base of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the entire structure and provides stability.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop Connector
parts.Basic_description: A metal connector piece located beneath the tabletop.
parts.Functional_description: Connects and secures the tabletop to the side panels.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: The flat upper surface of the table made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: Provides a working surface for writing, placing objects, or using a computer.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.
